entities.title: mulberry32
entities.relevance: A small 32-bit generator built from Math.imul and shifts, so every engine computes the same sequence from a seed.

entities.title: Taylor series of the sine
entities.relevance: dsin evaluates the sine's Taylor series about 0 to the x¹¹ term, in nested form, on an angle folded into [−π/2, π/2].
